name: OtterBox Hardline iPad Air
removable: No (certificate: do not open the equipment; no parts intended to be replaced)
statusNote: Its IECEx certificate was cancelled in March 2025 and OtterBox no longer promotes it; we found no end-of-sale notice.
summary: The OtterBox Hardline iPad Air is a restricted-breathing (Ex nR) case for the iPad Air (5th generation, M1) 10.9-inch, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. The tablet inside is a standard iPad Air (5th generation, M1) 10.9-inch running iPadOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management. It has been discontinued.

otherSchemes: ESD-safe, UV F1, flame HB (press release)

iecex.marking: Ex nR IIC T6 Gc / Ex tc IIIC 65°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: UL: Class I Div 2 Groups A-D; Class II Div 2 Groups F, G; Class III (press release; UL certification not re-checked)

safety.conditions: Do not open the equipment. No parts, including the gaskets and seals, are intended to be replaced. If service is required, contact the manufacturer.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Hardline Charging Station (single or four-bay, Qi, office/warehouse use), hand strap, breakaway shoulder strap, Tech-Touch safety gloves (separate purchase). Ex rating of accessories not stated.

os.name: iPadOS
os.edition: iPadOS (consumer; no LTSC or enterprise edition)
os.updates: Security updates guaranteed until at least March 2027 (Apple's minimum)

specs.display: 10.9-inch Liquid Retina IPS LCD, P3, True Tone, antireflective coating
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi
specs.ports: USB-C; Smart Connector; magnetic Apple Pencil connector
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.
specs.gnss: GPS/GNSS on Wi-Fi + Cellular models; digital compass and Wi-Fi location on all
specs.keys: Top button with Touch ID sensor, volume buttons; no programmable hardware key
specs.pen: Apple Pencil (2nd generation), Apple Pencil (USB-C); magnetic attach and charge (2nd gen)
specs.ruggedness: MIL-STD-810H drop testing to four feet
specs.partNumbers: OBFTC-0135-A and OBFTC-0183-A (IECEx certificate models; which iPad each fits is not stated in sources read)

throughCase.label: Touchscreen
throughCase.value: Screen with a microdot pattern (IECEx issue 5)

throughCase.label: Charging
throughCase.value: Qi wireless charging station (single or four-bay, 15 W) sold with the system; no port stated

throughCase.label: SIM card
throughCase.value: Wi-Fi + Cellular option added in IECEx issue 1; SIM access not described

throughCase.label: Mounting points
throughCase.value: Hand strap and breakaway shoulder strap (accessories)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (third-party PTT apps over Wi-Fi/cellular; no PTT key; Ex-rated? n/a)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via app (camera-based scanning; no scan engine)

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Not possible (no NFC reader on any iPad)

capabilities.label: 3D scanning / LiDAR
capabilities.value: Not possible (no LiDAR on this iPad)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (FaceTime, Teams or remote-assist apps; needs camera and audio access through the case)

capabilities.label: Bluetooth gas detectors
capabilities.value: Via app (Bluetooth 5.0; vendor app; no maker-certified integration listed)
